difficulties.domain_knowledge: Recover a mixed pressure/normal-flow field, its transverse component and local speed; map the spatial field consistently into advection and mass transfer.
difficulties.failure_mode: Replace the nonuniform field with a uniform field at the same total flow.
difficulties.source_algorithm: Darcy mixed-boundary pressure and nonuniform flow; paper II.1/II.3, source 148–193

difficulties.domain_knowledge: Reconstruct sulfate and couple concentration-dependent migration, diffusion current and compatible boundary species/charge fluxes.
difficulties.failure_mode: Use excess-supporting-electrolyte conductivity, omit sulfate charge flux, or impose an incompatible inlet potential gradient.
difficulties.source_algorithm: Five-ion electroneutral Nernst–Planck transport; paper II.2/II.3, source 210–215 and 289–399

difficulties.domain_knowledge: Close bulk/surface reaction and two phase current fields simultaneously under opposite boundary currents and a common gauge.
difficulties.failure_mode: Substitute bulk-only BV or impose a spatially uniform reaction while retaining correct net current.
difficulties.source_algorithm: Finite surface transfer/BV with distributed two-phase galvanostatic closure; paper II.2/Appendix A, source 222–248 and 305–372

difficulties.domain_knowledge: Construct a convergent spatial/time approximation, maintain continuous concentration history at current changes, and include open-boundary inventory exchange.
difficulties.failure_mode: Reset at current changes, use steady-state replacement, or a numerically inadequate coarse approximation.
difficulties.source_algorithm: Continuous transient multi-ion inventory with open inlet/outlet and applied-current stages; paper II.2/II.3/III, source 336–399 and 727–769
